en: A black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing a long row of ornate late‑19th‑century townhouses with stucco facades and mansard roofs. Trees line the sidewalk, which is busy with pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing, including men in suits and hats and women in long dresses. Fenced front gardens and a few shopfronts occupy the ground floors. Large painted signs in German are visible on the facades.
